biotools.summary: This package provides a method to refit and correct the diploid region in copy number profiles. It uses a clustering algorithm to identify pathology-specific normal (diploid) chromosomes and then use their copy number signal to refit the whole profile.  The package is composed by three functions: DRrefit (the main function), ComputeNormalChromosome and PlotCluster.
